Structure: Prepare (Deploy View Prepare and Finish, mode prepare, awaited; sender HeyReach runs the LinkedIn lane chunked: identity LinkedIn URL + company, no first-name rule, the visible variables as customUserFields, 100 leads a chunk) -> GET campaign/GetById (exists, name, status, senders; DRAFT, FINISHED, CANCELED and a campaign with no sender refused) -> the send loop, one POST campaign/AddLeadsToCampaignV2 per chunk (answers counts only: added, updated = already there and refreshed, failed; a 4xx that is not 429 refuses the chunk by name), live progress on the launch row after every chunk -> read-back by walking POST campaign/GetLeadsFromCampaign 100 to a page to totalCount (membership = the profile URL is on the list, keyed the way Build Rows keyed the rows; capped at 80 pages, warned) -> Close Deploy (the key leaves the state) -> Finish (mode finish, awaited). Everything else, the launch row, the client, the campaign's Hub row, the table, the view, the field contract, the mirror row, DNC, the Max Rows cap, the stamps, the receipt and the Hub row, is the shared machine's; a failure inside it fails this run, which is the run the Error Logger names. Dedupe Mode on the launch row is ignored on this lane; HeyReach has none (a profile already in the campaign is updated, never added twice). No title gate: the view's relevance owns who is offered, and HeyReach enriches nothing at add time that could disagree with it.
